purpose: Metadata-only comparison and prospective design; no spectral access or adopted motion bank

observatory.provenance: GBT geodetic site values retained from config/hd156668b_m37_preflight.json; no target parameters are inherited

coordinate_scenarios: One fixed catalogue ICRS direction and each of the three fixed ON-header directions, evaluated over the same full cadence; neither is asserted to be the true pointing
distance_motion_policy: Infinite-distance fixed-direction observer correction. No unstated astrometric epoch, space-motion or parallax propagation. A 25-year proper-motion displacement is only a labelled scale comparison.
ephemeris: Astropy builtin (ERFA epv00), explicit packaged IERS-B, auto-download disabled
phase_policy: Equally spaced mean-anomaly offsets at first ON midpoint; all are diagnostic sampled cases, not a continuous completeness certificate
orbital_model: Edge-on, first-order Doppler, central P/a/e/omega from the retained composite snapshot; no absolute Tper time scale is presumed, no physical sensitivity claimed
